assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY is absent; the rough polygon is replaceable.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics and derived layers must be regenerated after official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: Three key-area polygons are provisional rough rectangles.
assumptions.impact: They are index frames only and cannot establish parcels, road redlines or precise area.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks and building control lines are absent.
assumptions.impact: These remain unknown and no design number is presented as an approved control.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, condition, ownership, tenants and heritage value are not surveyed.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are proposal envelopes; retain/renovate/demolish decisions require a later survey.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, station interfaces, traffic counts and parking supply are absent.
assumptions.impact: Road geometry expresses conceptual walking links only.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, energy capacity, drainage, flood, fire and communications data are absent.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure projects cannot pass the professional gate until engineering verification.

assumptions.statement: Formal heritage inventories, protection lines and view corridors are absent.
assumptions.impact: Cultural proposals remain reversible interpretation and cannot change protected fabric.

assumptions.statement: Named operators, budgets and public procurement authority are not committed.
assumptions.impact: Operators are governance suggestions; every pilot needs a signed owner and exit budget.
